source: Weldbend catalog 63rd ed. pp.170-171 (ft-lbs to produce indicated bolt stress; lubricated threads)
note: Only the 30/40/50/60 ksi rows are carried: they are mutually consistent (torque scales linearly with stress), which also exposed misprints in the catalog's low-stress rows. Values are guidance only — always follow the gasket manufacturer's tightening specification.
procedure: Align component parts and clamp together with hold down.
Lubricate stud (or bolt) threads in the area of nut engagement, and the face of nuts, with a suitable lubricant.
Install all bolts and nuts finger tight.
Number bolts so that torquing requirements can be followed.
Apply torque in 20% steps of required final torque, loading all bolts at each step before proceeding.
Tighten bolts in sequential (star) order — 0°-180°, 90°-270°, 45°-225°, 135°-315° — at each step until final torque is reached.
Continue tightening in rotational order until all bolts are stable at final torque. Two complete times around is usually required.
